source: Maa Win32 FramePool screenshots of employee work-plan dialogs

level_gating.rule: Assign crop C to worker W only if C is listed under W and the level gate passes: if min_level is an int, require worker_level >= min_level; if eligibility is observed_unlocked with min_level null, allow only for that slot (crop was unlocked on that worker dialog at capture time); needs_live_recording / locked_or_level_gated / unsupported never allocate.
level_gating.unknown_worker_level_policy: Do not invent worker_level. Numeric min_level without worker_level is allowed only when eligibility is observed_unlocked (prior proof on that slot).

notes: Only products visibly unlocked in the work-plan dialogs are schedulable.
The red strawberry icon is not assumed to produce 白玉草莓.
Energy is a current observation, not a verified speed measurement.
The mill has no assigned employee and is excluded.
schema_version 2 adds level gating. Numeric thresholds are null until live-recorded; existing products keep eligibility=observed_unlocked per slot from 2026-09-26 captures.
Do not treat unverified_visible or pending_capabilities as schedulable.
